content: guzzlehttp/guzzle latest stable is 8.0.x (PHP >=7.4,<8.6), a major bump from the 7.8 pinned in SPEC.md's composer.json. Guzzle 7.x (latest 7.10/7.11+) remains actively maintained and is the safer choice for a conservative university deployment - recommend ^7.10 rather than jumping to 8.0 on day one, revisit 8.x once the ecosystem (PSR interfaces, middleware packages) has caught up.
